svg.text: claudia creates — layouts and templates: templates on the server and in a deck (E10.22, E10.23)
Mock round of 22 Nov 2026, for review. Content is invented. A template (layouts and a theme, with a purpose) initialises a new deck’s own layouts and styles;
after that the deck relies only on its own copy. A template is an export of a presentation without slides; the administrator adds and removes them on the server.
K · File ▸ New: pick a template or start from nothing
Each template says what it is for. The first is built in and is a single empty slide.
A single empty slide. Start from
A short weekly status for people
A pitch to a sponsor: need, plan,
What would you like to achieve?
Describe your aim and the list narrows to templates made for it (E12.1). No AI is needed for this.
The template is copied into the new presentation. Later changes to the template never reach it.
Same pattern as Server settings ▸ Fonts (D1041). Removing a template never changes presentations made from it.
A 20-minute talk, one idea per slide
A formal briefing with a decision
Drop a template file here, or choose one
Anyone can make one with Save as template…; only the administrator can add it here.
Presentations made from a template are not affected when it is removed.
M · Format ▸ Template ▸ Change theme… and Change template…
Both copy into the deck’s own layouts and styles, matched by name. Styles and layouts of the deck with no match stay as they are.
9 styles replaced · 2 of yours have no match and stay
5 matched by name · “Two lists” has no match and stays
11 slides take their layout’s frames · 6 are unchanged
Anyone can make a template file from a deck; the administrator adds it to a server.
A 20-minute talk: one idea per slide, a few strong pictures.
Writes a Claudia export of this presentation without its slides: its 8 layouts and its theme (24 styles, palette).
Send the file to your server’s administrator, who can add it under Server settings ▸ Templates.
